Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: N/A

The cutting-edge helm of Sandayu Oda, Hanako Arasaka’s personal bodyguard and one of the most dangerous people alive today. Oda differs from his master’s (Goro Takemura) preference for discretion, and fully embodies the cyberninja life. As part of this, Oda used his effectively limitless security budget to provide himself gear unlike anything else in the world. This ‘Kagami’ helmet is actually the first Neo-Kabuto, with the rest being patterned off Oda’s designs. If you ever see this helm’s blood-red holographic Oni mask staring back at you from the shadows, run. Faster than you’ve ever ran in your likely soon-to-expire life.

Iconic SP 13 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. All ablation this armor would suffer is reduced by 1 (Minimum 0). Comes with built-in TUp (+1 Slot) Smart Glasses (w/ Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, and Targeting Scope). While worn by a user with Melee Weapon Skill Level 7 or higher and Evasion Skill Level 7 or higher, or Combat Awareness Rank 6 or higher, this helmet’s cutting-edge software provides a +1 bonus to all Melee Weapon (+2 for Aimed Shots) and Evasion Skill Checks. Anyone attempting to target this helmet’s wearer with Smart or Improved Smart Ammunition suffers a -2 penalty to their Attack Check. After this armor spends 10 minutes not losing any SP, it completely repairs itself to SP 13.

Cost: Super Luxury (Iconic; Fabrication: N/A)
Covers: Head
SP: 13
Armor Penalty: none

Foundry notes:

  • The +1s are automated while equipped; add the extra point on Aimed Shots by hand, and disable the effect if you don't qualify.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Iconics > Iconic Armor).
